name: Cosmik brand kit
system_status: baseline approved (owner, 2026-10-07); HPLX family approved (owner, 2026-10-15); Tectra family and angle-only Latch approved (owner, 2026-10-17)
wordmark_status: outlined trace of the approved banner (kits/cosmik/assets/vector/cosmik-lockup-*.svg), accepted (owner, 2026-10-11); the approved raster stays the reference
interim_identity: Small identity where the lockup would be too large: the emblem followed by the live label “Cosmik” in Inter 500 (type role identity-label, 20 px / 1.3, tracking 0). The label is a typographic treatment, not a wordmark; never set COSMIK in capitals with Inter to imitate the wordmark.

known_gaps.summary: No optically redrawn small-size Cosmik emblem: the 16–64 px renders and kits/cosmik/icons/cosmik.* are faithful reductions of the master geometry, and the fine cut and isolated point lose definition at favicon sizes. HPLX Ember has an optical redraw for 16–48 px (kits/hplx/assets/ember-small.source.json), used by kits/hplx/icons/hplx-ember.*, accepted (owner, 2026-10-11).
Chromium checks cover all three kits. Full browser zoom, other browser engines and assistive-technology checks remain pending. See specimens/validation.md.
Glimmer uses the approved geometry at all sizes. No separate optical redraw or platform icon pack is supplied. Historical Ember icons remain deprecated.
